blocks.text: Operators of every size run it, from MVNOs preparing a launch to tier-1 groups with millions of subscribers on several continents.
We have built telecom software for more than two decades. Headquarters are in Austin, Texas, with teams in Denver, Mexico City, Rio de Janeiro, Guayaquil, Mumbai and Mauritius.
Our people have spent decades in operator networks and billing. We design for legacy integration and multi-vendor environments, and for migrations on live networks.
Our products work with the equipment and systems an operator already has, over standard interfaces.
Every customer has a customer success manager, and 24x7 support staffed by engineers.
